Engine Quirk.name: Engine Quirk
Engine Quirk.description:
🏎️ You have engines in your calves that power fast runs and hard kicks.

🌱 At the start you run fifty meters in a few seconds on clear ground, with traction, braking room and time to notice hazards.
📈 With training: controlled turns, interceptions, passenger carries, short overdrive, longer high-speed runs with stronger regrown exhausts.
⚠️ You need orange juice; blocked pipes, fizzy drinks or heat stall your engines until you clear and cool them, and speed gives no armor or faster thought.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Cooldown, as overdrive temporarily stalls your engines.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Tenya Iida's Engine. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Running +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Calf Motor Dash, Driven Heel Strike
Engine Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: calf engines with exhausts. Start: 50 m in a few seconds on clear level ground, a running kick; high gears, sharp turns, safe passengers need training.
Limits: needs fuel (orange juice helps); soda or blocked exhausts stall it; overuse overheats; a stall needs cooling and cleared pipes. Needs traction, braking room, a visible route; speed gives no protection or faster thought. Long overdrive needs stronger exhausts regrown in prior training; learning it is not enough.
Quirk Strain: light: short dash, restrained kick; moderate: interception, capture, passenger run, throttle feint; heavy: 10-second overdrive; severe: max kick, sustained high gear, cooled distance run.
Drawback: built in, the canon Cooldown.
Canon: Tenya Iida's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: crowd racing and public combat need a license; user answers for collisions and exhaust burns.
Look: calf exhaust pipes.
